notes.raw: * ''Toxic Shot'' deals [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc]] [[File:Blaze.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent damage]] [[:Damage|damage over time]], and does not trigger [[File:Blackfire Torch item.png|20px|link=Ability effects|An icon representing the keyword Ability effects]] [[:Ability effects|spell effects]]. ** Despite this, it is special cased to trigger [[File:Dark Harvest rune.png|20xpx|link=Dark Harvest|An icon representing Dark Harvest]] [[Dark Harvest]], but not [[File:Cheap Shot rune.png|20xpx|link=Cheap Shot|An icon representing Cheap Shot]] [[Cheap Shot]], [[File:Conqueror rune.png|20xpx|link=Conqueror|An icon representing Conqueror]] [[Conqueror]], [[File:Scorchclaw's Slash buff.png|20xpx|border|link=Scorchclaw's Slash|An icon representing the Scorchclaw's Slash neutral buff]] [[Scorchclaw's Slash]], [[File:Summon Aery rune.png|20xpx|link=Summon Aery|An icon representing Summon Aery]] [[Summon Aery]] and [[File:Ocean Dragon Soul buff.png|20xpx|border|link=Ocean Dragon Soul|An icon representing the Ocean Dragon Soul neutral buff]] [[Ocean Dragon Soul]]. * The damage per tick is not updated dynamically based on '''Teemo's''' current ability power. * The initial hit from ''Toxic Shot'' will consume [[File:Manaflow Band rune.png|20xpx|link=Manaflow Band|An icon representing Manaflow Band]] [[Manaflow Band]] if it is available. * The attacks do not affect [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]] nor [[File:Ward_icon.png|20px|link=Ward|An icon representing the keyword Ward]] [[:Ward|wards]].
notes.text:
Toxic Shot deals proc damage over time, and does not trigger spell effects.
* Despite this, it is special cased to trigger Dark Harvest, but not Cheap Shot, Conqueror, Scorchclaw's Slash, Summon Aery and Ocean Dragon Soul.
The damage per tick is not updated dynamically based on Teemo's current ability power.
The initial hit from Toxic Shot will consume Manaflow Band if it is available.
The attacks do not affect structures nor wards.
